reasons: Content treatment fields match the lake treatment fields: field_i_validity good_law, as_of_content 2008-06-23, as_of_treatment 2026-06-30, composite_basis migration-seed, varies_by_point false.

reviewed.suggested_tightening: Surface the migration-seed/audit-needed limitation beside the rendered treatment badge if users may read the badge as fully re-derived treatment.
